data.name: CompatibilityWarningText
data.value:
Here you can find advanced compatibility options. These options can solve compatibility problems or make the game faster as well as make the game unstable or not functional.
Empire Earth is an old game and although it requires very little performance, it will run poorly on many computers, especially laptops.
However you should be able to solve many problems with these options, but finding the right combination of settings can take some time.
data.comment: Warning shown before the compatibility options; the box has room for about 14 lines of 50 characters.

data.name: CompatibilityWarningConfirm
data.comment: Button that closes the compatibility warning.

data.comment: Type of an installation: the current community setup; at most about 16 characters.

data.comment: Type of an installation: the community setup 1.7.2 or older; at most about 16 characters.

data.name: InstallationKindForeign
data.comment: Type of an installation: retail CD, GOG, a copy; at most about 16 characters.

data.name: InstallationKindCommunityHint
data.value: Installed by the current community setup.
data.comment: Tooltip of the type Community setup.

data.name: InstallationKindCommunityLegacyHint
data.value: Installed by the community setup 1.7.2 or older. Run the current setup to update it.
data.comment: Tooltip of the type Older setup.

data.name: InstallationKindForeignHint
data.value: Not installed by the community setup, for example from the CD, by GOG or copied.
data.comment: Tooltip of the type Other.

data.name: InstallationStateOk
data.comment: State of an installation: its programs are there.

data.name: InstallationStateDamaged
data.comment: State of an installation: a program is missing (often deleted by an antivirus); at most about 12 characters.

data.name: InstallationStateFolderMissing
data.comment: State of an installation: the chosen folder does not exist; at most about 12 characters.

data.name: InstallationMissingProgramsFormat
data.comment: Tooltip of a damaged installation. {0}: the missing programs, e.g. Empire Earth.exe.

data.name: InstallationDamagedFormat
data.value: {0} is missing in {1}. Antivirus programs often delete or quarantine game files: restore it from the quarantine, or repair the installation with its setup.
data.comment: Hint below the list when the selected installation is damaged. {0}: the missing programs, {1}: their folder.

data.name: InstallationsSharedSettingsFormat
data.value: {0} installations of {1} use the same game settings ({2}): the settings, including the game folder stored there, are the same for all of them.
data.comment: Hint below the list when several installations share one game settings key. {0}: number of installations, {1}: Empire Earth or NeoEE, {2}: registry key.

data.name: InstallationSharedRootFormat
data.value: Empire Earth and NeoEE are installed in the same folder ({0}). The launcher uses {1}, which was installed last; uninstalling one of them also removes files of the other.
data.comment: Hint below the list (contract O11). {0}: the folder, {1}: Empire Earth or NeoEE.

data.name: InstallationNewerSetupFormat
data.value: {0} was installed by a newer setup than this launcher knows. Please update the launcher.
data.comment: Hint below the list (contract 5). {0}: the install folder.
